get_random_fact.description: Get one random Pokémon fact as plain text, ready to post in a chat or use later in the workflow. Choose a generation for a fact about its Pokémon, or leave it empty for a fact about generations 1 to 3. No API key required.

mock_response.fact: Mewtwo comes before Mew in the Pokedex despite being created from its modified DNA.

get_random_fact.name: get_random_fact

parameters.description: Optional. Only facts about the Pokémon a generation introduced, from 1 (Kanto) to 9 (Paldea). Pokéfacts finds them by the Pokémon names in each fact, so the match is approximate: a fact can also mention Pokémon from other generations. Leave it empty and the facts come from generations 1 to 3 only, one of the three picked at random each run.
parameters.name: generation

generation.description: The generation the facts were asked about, 1 to 9. Null when none was chosen, in which case Pokéfacts picked one of generations 1 to 3.

get_random_facts.description: Get up to 50 random Pokémon facts in one step, all different, for a daily digest, a quiz or a batch of posts. Choose a generation for facts about its Pokémon, or leave it empty for facts about generations 1 to 3. No API key required.

facts: Eevee has the most branched Evolutions, with a total of eight.
Pikachu has the most event-exclusive moves available to it.
Magikarp was the first Pokémon featured in Professor Oak's Pokémon Lecture in EP061.

get_random_facts.name: get_random_facts

parameters.description: Optional. How many facts to get, 1 to 50. 5 by default. The facts in one answer are always different from each other.
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Optional. Only facts about the Pokémon a generation introduced, from 1 (Kanto) to 9 (Paldea). Pokéfacts finds them by the Pokémon names in each fact, so the match is approximate: a fact can also mention Pokémon from other generations. Leave it empty and the facts come from generations 1 to 3 only, one of the three picked at random each run.
parameters.name: generation

count.description: How many facts came back: the number asked for.

facts.description: The facts, each as plain text, in random order and never the same fact twice.

generation.description: The generation the facts were asked about, 1 to 9. Null when none was chosen, in which case Pokéfacts picked one of generations 1 to 3.

description: Get random Pokémon facts from Pokéfacts, a free, community-run collection of over 3,600 of them: one at a time or up to 50 at once, from any generation of Pokémon, 1 to 9. No account or API key required. Disclaimer: this is an independent integration with the community-run Pokéfacts API (pokefacts.vercel.app).
